<observation>
  <type>change</type>
  <title>Quarterly Business Review template for Yamaha engagement tracking</title>
  <subtitle>Created org-mode capture template to standardize QBR sessions covering delivery, impact, roadmap, strategic recommendations, and renewal discussions.</subtitle>
  <facts>
    <fact>QBR template captures quarter identifier, attendees from both Yamaha and Sedin sides, and auto-timestamps session</fact>
    <fact>Template structures five core sections: deliverables with business impact, technology roadmap state/shifts/focus, strategic recommendation (unsolicited), next quarter priorities, and renewal/expansion discussion</fact>
    <fact>Action items table includes owner and due date columns for commitment tracking</fact>
    <fact>Template includes reminder to send written summary to Yamaha within 24 hours of session</fact>
    <fact>Nine capture templates now defined for Yamaha engagement: standups (ys), client meetings (ym), internal syncs (yi), commitments (yc), risks (yr), architecture decisions (ya), vendor evaluations (yv), technical debt (yt), security findings (yx)</fact>
  </facts>
  <narrative>A Quarterly Business Review template was created to standardize executive-level touchpoints with Yamaha Music Innovation Fund stakeholders. The template enforces the strategic partner communication pattern defined in the role plan: translating technical delivery into business language, presenting roadmap evolution, bringing one unsolicited strategic recommendation per quarter (the "trusted advisor signal"), and naturally surfacing renewal/expansion conversations. The structure aligns to the QBR cadence described in the engagement plan (60-90 minute structured sessions covering delivery, impact, roadmap alignment) and embeds the 24-hour written summary commitment. This template joins eight other Yamaha-specific org-mode captures (standups, meetings, syncs, commitments, risks, ADRs, vendor evaluations, technical debt, security findings) that file to refile.org for the role holder to process. The QBR template's "strategic recommendation" section operationalizes the Fractional CTO's innovation pipeline responsibility—bringing relevant technology opportunities (AI in music, data monetization, emerging platforms) framed as business opportunities first.</narrative>

It is the single\\npoint of authority between Yamaha Music Innovation Fund and all of Sedin's internal\\nunits, operating across three layers simultaneously:\\n\\n- *Technical:* Own the technology vision, architecture decisions, and engineering\\n  standards across everything being built for Yamaha\\n- *External:* Be the face, voice, and conscience of the entire engagement for Yamaha\\n- *Internal:* Force coherence across Code Rapper, Data Culture, Marketing, and\\n  Tarka Labs before anything touches the client\\n\\nThe existential risk: Yamaha sees four vendors in a trenchcoat with no shared\\ntechnical direction.
